units.quote: Material discrepancies between the name recorded on the application, the applicant's evidence of U.S. citizenship/non-citizen U.S. nationality, or the evidence of identity must be documented by submission of one or more of the documents listed in this section
units.meaning: If there are material discrepancies between the name recorded on the application and either the evidence of U.S. citizenship/non-citizen U.S. nationality or the evidence of identity, the applicant must document them by submitting one or more of the documents specified in this section.

units.quote: (see an exception for married names in 8 FAM 403.1-4(C))
scope_quotes: Material discrepancies between the name recorded on the application, the applicant's evidence of U.S. citizenship/non-citizen U.S. nationality, or the evidence of identity must be documented by submission of one or more of the documents listed in this section
units.meaning: An exception to the requirement to document material name discrepancies applies for married names pursuant to 8 FAM 403.1-4(C).

scope_quotes: Acceptable means of documenting a material name change include (per 22 CFR 51.25):
units.meaning: Under 22 CFR 51.25, court orders or decrees in the form of name change orders are an acceptable means of documenting a material name change.

scope_quotes: Acceptable means of documenting a material name change include (per 22 CFR 51.25):
units.meaning: Under 22 CFR 51.25, court orders or decrees in the form of divorce decrees are an acceptable means of documenting a material name change.

scope_quotes: Acceptable means of documenting a material name change include (per 22 CFR 51.25):
units.meaning: Under 22 CFR 51.25, certificates of naturalization constitute an acceptable means of documenting a material name change.

scope_quotes: Acceptable means of documenting a material name change include (per 22 CFR 51.25):
units.meaning: Under 22 CFR 51.25, marriage certificates constitute an acceptable means of documenting a material name change.

units.quote: (4) Documentation demonstrating change of name by operation of state law; or
scope_quotes: Acceptable means of documenting a material name change include (per 22 CFR 51.25):
units.meaning: Under 22 CFR 51.25, documentation showing a name change occurred by operation of state law constitutes an acceptable means of documenting a material name change.
